result.note: Tested the US specialty-medicine tariff exemption for India and the October 2026 Modi-Trump call; skipped Jaishankar's remarks as commentary.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, the United States announced exemptions from its new pharmaceutical tariffs for specialty medicines. Consider the following statements:
items: Generic medicines supplied by India are covered by the exemption.
India was named among 20 eligible suppliers under the exemption.
The exempted categories include cell and gene therapies.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Generics stay outside the programme and remain tied to a pending security review. The exemption covers rare-disease, fertility, and cell and gene therapies. TBB reads it as Washington giving aligned partners targeted relief while holding back the comprehensive trade deal as leverage.
questions.source: The US named India among 20 eligible suppliers of specialty medicines exempt from its new pharmaceutical tariffs, covering rare-disease, fertility, and cell and gene therapies, though generics stay outside the programme and tied to a pending security review.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the phone call between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and US President Donald Trump in October 2026:
items: It was their first conversation since June 2026.
The leaders reviewed trade, defence and energy.
It came days after the US Russia-oil tariff law took effect.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: All three are correct. The call came as Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal flew to the G20 trade meeting to meet Greer, and the India-US trade deal remained unsigned.
questions.source: Modi called Trump, their first conversation since June, reviewing trade, defence, and energy days after the Russia-oil tariff law took effect and as Goyal flew to the G20 trade meeting to see Greer.
